concept: A fragmented digital landscape viewed through a corrupted lens: pixelated blocks of code and data streams flowing chaotically, with jagged geometric shapes colliding mid-air against a backdrop of crumbling infrastructure. Color palette: cold blues, grays, and rust-red. Multiple planes or objects rupturing simultaneously. Abstract, dystopian, composed as if seen through a degraded security camera feed or corrupted digital display. Heavy shadows and sharp edges dominating.
explanation: Today's news is dominated by systems failing catastrophically—digital (Binance hack, Google stock collapse), mechanical (helicopter and train collisions), geopolitical (electoral disputes, conflicts, court failures), and physical (rock collapse). Each story involves either collision, breach, loss of control, or structural breakdown. Rather than depicting any single incident, this image captures the underlying pattern: the simultaneous malfunction of systems we depend on, viewed as abstract chaos rather than specific tragedy.

headlines.title: Crypto giant Binance hit by hack suspected to be largest in history
headlines.summary: Two analytics firms have attributed the incident to a North Korean hacking unit called TraderTraitor.

headlines.title: Mushroom murderer fails to overturn convictions in Australian court challenge
headlines.summary: Erin Patterson argued her trial was unfair due to seven grounds but three appeal judges dismissed them all.

headlines.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
headlines.summary: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.

headlines.title: Three dead after two helicopters collide midair near Oregon airport
headlines.summary: The collision involving a Robinson R22 and an Airbus helicopter occurred on Thursday afternoon, with both aircraft crashing in a field adjacent to a highway.

headlines.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
headlines.summary: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.

headlines.title: 'The city is alive': A brief peace in Kherson, but residents fear what comes next
headlines.summary: A temporary ceasefire has brought rare quiet to Kherson, offering its residents a glimpse of normal life before fighting resumes.

headlines.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as AI fears rattle Wall Street
headlines.summary: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI search summaries were affecting ad revenue.

headlines.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
headlines.summary: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

headlines.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
headlines.summary: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

headlines.title: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
headlines.summary: Ursula von der Leyen continued to use the term "associate member" for Canada despite some opposition of the bloc's members, including Germany.

headlines.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
headlines.summary: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

headlines.title: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports
headlines.summary: One of the region's famous rock formations, known as "fairy chimneys", reportedly collapsed outside an open-air museum.
